messages:
Kai W: FYI I'm opening a consolidated PR that addresses structured-output contracts + tool-calling migration edge cases. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1487
Mia Chen: thanks — can you list the exact files you'll touch so I can split SDK snippets work?
Kai W: touch list: docs/guides/output-contracts.md, docs/migration/sdk-v2-tool-calls.md, examples/js/structured-output.js, examples/python/tool-calls.py, and a few anchors in concepts/guardrails.md
Raj Patel: I'll take the migration guide (sdk-v2-tool-calls.md). planning to add a short note about changing `tools` -> `tool_calls` and the rationale.
Olivia M: I'll own the examples. want me to add a failing-case example for partial outputs + truncated KV cache?
Kai W: yes please. also include a small example showing an explicit `error` object in the structured output when a tool fails — that was a customer ask.
Mia Chen: I'll update JS + Python SDK snippets: show both the old call shape and the new `tool_calls` schema. small diff in the client: `client.callTool(...)` -> `client.invokeTool(...)` in v2, so include both.
Samir: I can run a quick link sweep for anchors. Found two broken anchors already: concepts/structured-output#schema vs #json-schema. I'll fix those in the PR.
DocsBot: Preview: CI lint ok, build preview URL: https://deploy-preview-1487--docs.redwood.ai
Raj Patel: Question — for the JSON schema we want `nullable` vs `oneOf: [null, {...}]`? some validators behave differently. My vote: prefer `oneOf` for widest compatibility and a short note about validator differences.
Mia Chen: Agreed. Also add an explicit `examples` array in the schema for each variant so the SDK docs can auto-render sample payloads.
Kai W: quick suggested schema snippet to include in the guide (use in docs/examples):
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "result": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
    "tool_calls": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "name": {"type": "string"},
          "args": {"type": "object"},
          "error": {"type": ["object", "null"]}
        },
        "required": ["name"]
      }
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
Olivia M: Nice. Can we also show a small parser pattern for consumers that need to be tolerant to extra fields? e.g., `const safe = (o) => o.result ?? o.alternate ?? ''`
Mia Chen: I'll add SDK snippet about parsing fallback and mention `strict_validation: false` flag for the server-side guardrail check.
Samir: After PR is up, I'll run a sitemap + linkcheck and post results. If we need to create redirects for renamed anchors I can add them.
Kai W: timeline: aiming to merge by EOD Friday. Label the PR with `docs:needs-review` and tag @olivia @mia @raj for review.
Raj Patel: I'll add migration checklist items: sample diff block, deprecation note, and a small rollback example (how to fallback to older `tools` shape).
Mia Chen: For the JS snippet, include both CommonJS and ESM variants + an inline comment showing the changed field name. Keep snippets < 20 lines.
Olivia M: I'll add an interactive example in the examples folder that the docs site will render — shows a tool error and how the structured `error` object surfaces.
Kai W: perfect. Samir once you run linkcheck can you also sanity-check the example URLs in the site preview?
Samir: yup. I'll post results as a follow-up comment on the PR.
DocsBot: Reminder: you have 2 reviewers requested: @Mia Chen, @Olivia M
Kai W: thanks team — I'll push the initial PR in 10m. Please comment inline if something is missing.
Mia Chen: cool, will start drafting SDK snippet patches after PR is created.
Olivia M: will draft example tests so CI can catch regressions.
Raj Patel: noted, will include a short JSON schema compat table for validators (ajv / jsonschema / python-jsonschema)..
Samir: posting linkcheck after merge unless you want pre-merge run — pre-merge is fine for me.
Kai W: pre-merge please. last call: anything else?
Mia Chen: add a short note about tokenization impact on structured outputs (long `args` fields can blow up token usage).
Kai W: good catch — add a sentence under cost considerations.
Olivia M: done — I'll add a small screenshot of the rendered example too.
Kai W: thanks everyone, closing thread when PR is up.
